report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry contradicts the alert: traces show one OK checkout span (60ms), metrics show error_rate 0.001 and p95 72ms, and logs show a 200 request_complete. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration). The alert cannot be substantiated from admitted evidence, so hand off for broader telemetry.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing the actual error-rate and latency spike (current gateway data shows error_rate 0.001, p95 72ms, all OK)
Per-service error/latency metrics for order, payment, inventory, postgresql, redis to localize the fault
Trace spans with downstream durations or error statuses beyond the single OK gateway checkout span
Logs at WARN/ERROR level or non-200 responses during the alert window
